name: SocialLinks - On Light, Brand Colours
description: The row as the chapter and community Connect sections render it: each mark in its own brand colour on a white badge. The accounts come from settings rather than a fixture, which is the point of the component — the footer, the Contact band and every chapter row read one list and cannot disagree about which accounts exist. No envelope, because a Connect row is not one of the surfaces that shows the shared inbox.
